business_problem: Accenture's marketing organization spent too much time on research, analysis, and campaign coordination across a large global operation, so the company needed a way to reduce manual steps, speed campaign preparation, and help marketers focus on strategic work instead of repetitive process tasks.
solution_summary: Accenture used AI Refinery and SynOps to turn marketing execution into an agentic workflow instead of a chain of manual tasks. SynOps first created a unified operational layer for campaign governance, cross-system data integration, centralized KPIs, and real-time performance reporting, already reducing manual campaign-management steps by 55 percent. Accenture then layered AI Refinery on top as an enterprise framework built on NVIDIA AI Foundry, NVIDIA AI Enterprise, and NVIDIA Omniverse Enterprise. Powered by SynOps, proprietary data, and selected third-party sources, the solution gives marketers a shared interface to 14 AI agents covering skills such as research, analytics, editorial scheduling, critical thinking, and forecasting. Those agents collaborate in intention-driven workflows, pulling information from internal research, Moody's Analytics NewsEdge, and the web to create campaign briefs, recommendations, and timing guidance in minutes instead of days or weeks.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA AI Enterprise
solution_components.role: Provides enterprise AI infrastructure capabilities supporting the agentic marketing environment.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Omniverse Enterprise
solution_components.role: Forms part of the AI Refinery stack used to support scalable enterprise AI solutions.

solution_components.name: Research Agent
solution_components.role: Summarizes internal and external sources into concise campaign intelligence for marketers.

data_flow: Campaign data and KPIs from disparate systems are integrated through SynOps into a unified operational layer. Marketers then interact with AI Refinery, whose agents draw from proprietary research, third-party sources such as Moody's Analytics NewsEdge, and web content to generate briefs, research summaries, scheduling guidance, and recommendations that are surfaced back through the shared interface for human review and refinement.
business_outcome: Accenture reduced manual marketing effort, accelerated campaign preparation and decision-making, improved governance and visibility across programs, and created an agentic operating model that lets marketers spend more time on creative and strategic work.
